steps.code: <?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; if (wp_get_theme('twentytwentyfive')->exists()) { switch_theme('twentytwentyfive'); } foreach (array('Homepage','Shop','Cart','Checkout','My Account') as $title) { $id = wp_insert_post(array('post_title' => $title, 'post_content' => 'Local synthetic sample content for control validation only.', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_type' => 'page')); if ($title === 'Homepage') { update_option('show_on_front', 'page'); update_option('page_on_front', $id); } if ($title === 'Shop') update_option('woocommerce_shop_page_id', $id); if ($title === 'Cart') update_option('woocommerce_cart_page_id', $id); if ($title === 'Checkout') update_option('woocommerce_checkout_page_id', $id); if ($title === 'My Account') update_option('woocommerce_myaccount_page_id', $id); } if (class_exists('WC_Product_Simple')) { $product = new WC_Product_Simple(); $product->set_name('Local Sample Virtual Download'); $product->set_status('publish'); $product->set_catalog_visibility('visible'); $product->set_virtual(true); $product->set_downloadable(true); $product->set_regular_price('0'); $product->save(); } update_option('permalink_structure', '/%postname%/'); flush_rewrite_rules();
